Hotkeys</a></li> </ul> <h3 id="fusion-training-training-resources">Fusion Training (Training resources)</h3> <h4 id="fusion-training-1">Fusion Training</h4> <h5 id="getting-started-with-fusion-1">Getting Started with Fusion</h5> <p>Have you just installed your brand new copy of Fusion® on your Windows computer? Our Basic Training will help get you up and running with this powerful screen magnification and screen reader combination.</p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/fusion/getting-started/">Fusion Getting Started</a></p> <h5 id="fusion-videos-1">Fusion Videos</h5> <p>Check out and subscribe to the <a href="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLk-npwu4WEBSwNNSROcuZZnsI-ElqsLCT">Freedom Scientific Training YouTube channel</a>. Our videos offer quick tips and hints for both new and experienced Fusion users. Watch a video to learn something new or refresh your skills.</p> <h5 id="fusion-faqs-1">Fusion FAQs</h5> <p>Need help accessing a particular feature of Fusion? Want to get more out of your user experience? Check out our Fusion training FAQs for answers to your burning questions.</p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/fusion/frequently-asked-questions/">Fusion FAQs</a></p> <h5 id="fusion-the-ultimate-accessibility-tool-2">Fusion, the Ultimate Accessibility Tool</h5> <p>Fusion combines two of the best vision accessibility tools available – ZoomText® Magnifier/Reader and JAWS® for Windows screen reader – into a single installation.</p> <p>Need more information on how to use the visual aspects of Fusion? We’ve compiled a trove of ZoomText resources to get you started and answer your most pressing ZoomText questions. To learn more, visit our <a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/zoomtext/">ZoomText Training Resources.</a></p> <p>From experienced JAWS users who are just venturing into a world of magnification with their residual vision, to beginners who have never used speech; our JAWS training covers it all. Once you’ve mastered the visual aspects of Fusion, visit our <a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/">JAWS Training Resources</a> to learn more and continue harnessing the power of Fusion.</p> <h5 id="fusion-hotkeys-3">Fusion Hotkeys</h5> <p>Fusion uses a combination of ZoomText magnification hotkeys and JAWS screen reading hotkeys to control magnification and speech.</p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/fusion/hotkeys/">Fusion Hotkeys</a></p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/">Back to Training Center﻿</a></p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/fusion/getting-started/">Getting Started with Fusion</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/fusion/frequently-asked-questions/">Fusion FAQ</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/fusion/hotkeys/">Fusion Hotkeys</a></li> </ul> <h3 id="getting-started">Getting Started</h3> <h4 id="protected-getting-started">Protected: Getting Started</h4> <h3 id="getting-started-with-fusion-2">Getting Started with Fusion</h3> <h4 id="getting-started-with-fusion-3">Getting Started with Fusion</h4> <p>Welcome to your new software. Now that Fusion has been successfully installed on your computer, it’s time to take a look at its features and powerful user interface to see what all it can do.</p> <h5 id="launching-fusion">Launching Fusion</h5> <p>There are a few different ways to launch Fusion: from the desktop, from the run dialog box or by using a hotkey. The method is up to you, but here are tips for all three.</p> <h6 id="launching-fusion-from-the-desktop">Launching Fusion from the Desktop</h6> <p>When Fusion is installed, a Fusion shortcut is placed on your desktop.</p> <p>You can activate it using a left mouse double-click, or by navigating there with the keyboard and then pressing ENTER. Once Fusion is launched, both magnification and speech run simultaneously, and the Fusion user interface is displayed.</p> <h6 id="launching-fusion-from-the-run-dialog-box">Launching Fusion from the Run Dialog Box</h6> <p>You can easily launch Fusion from the Run dialog box. Using the keyboard, press WINDOWS Key+R to open run. Type FusionVer#, where Ver# is the Fusion version number, for example, Fusion2019, and press ENTER to launch the application.</p> <h6 id="launching-fusion-when-windows-starts">Launching Fusion When Windows Starts</h6> <p>Once Fusion is running, you can enable and disable the Start Fusion automatically when Windows starts option in Program Preferences. To do this, select the Fusion menu > Preferences > Program > Start Fusion Automatically when Windows starts.</p> <h5 id="the-fusion-user-interface">The Fusion User Interface</h5> <p>The Fusion user interface is displayed in a separate window when Fusion is launched and gives you quick access to a variety of magnification and speech options. You can easily adjust magnification level, and quickly set color, pointer, cursor and focus enhancements.</p> <p>The Fusion user interface also includes the Fusion menu, magnifier tab, reader tab and tools tab for your convenience.</p> <h5 id="using-speech-with-fusion">Using Speech with Fusion</h5> <p>When you first launch Fusion, speech is on by default. Toggle speech on or off using the Voice button on the Reader tab of the Fusion toolbar.</p> <p>Quickly adjust the voice rate by clicking the Rate box arrows.</p> <h5 id="fusion-faqs-2">Fusion FAQs</h5> <p>Need help accessing a particular feature of Fusion? Want to get more out of your user experience? Check out our <a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/fusion/frequently-asked-questions/">Fusion FAQs</a> for answers to your burning questions.</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/fusion/getting-started/">Getting Started with Fusion</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/fusion/frequently-asked-questions/">Fusion FAQ</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/fusion/hotkeys/">Fusion Hotkeys</a></li> </ul> <h3 id="getting-started-with-jaws-1">Getting Started With JAWS</h3> <h4 id="getting-started-with-jaws-2">Getting Started With JAWS</h4> <p>If you are new to JAWS® and wondering where to start, the Basic Training lessons on this page will teach you how to begin using some of the more commonly used JAWS features. Each module takes you step-by-step through performing many common tasks including starting JAWS, adjusting speech, reading documents, browsing the Internet, and much more. As you work through a lesson, try using the various features on your computer as the instructor demonstrates them.</p> <p>DAISY MP3 HTML</p> <p>The JAWS Basic Training is available in DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System) format and contains both text and audio. You can read it using the FSReader DAISY reader included with JAWS or using any hardware or software DAISY player.</p> <p>For your convenience, the Basic Training is also available as MP3 audio files, if you prefer to listen to the training on an MP3 player or another device, and as HTML files for you to read.</p> <h5 id="basic-training-daisy-books-for-jaws">Basic Training DAISY Books for JAWS</h5> <p>These DAISY files are packaged within ZIP files for downloading. After downloading them, you may extract them to any location on your computer. You can then play them using Freedom Scientific’s FSReader DAISY software player, or a different software or hardware DAISY player. To play a DAISY book with FSReader, do the following:</p> <ul> <li><p>Open FSReader.</p></li> <li><p>Press ALT+F to open the File menu and then O. The Open dialog box appears.</p></li> <li><p>Browse to the location where you extracted the DAISY files. The ncc.html file appears in the list. It contains key elements such as headings to help you navigate the DAISY book.</p></li> <li><p>Select the ncc.html file to open the DAISY book and play the file. Note: The Basic Training for JAWS is generic, and is not specific to any particular version. The lessons teach concepts and as time goes on, both JAWS and Windows will change. Also, your computer, as well as your version of JAWS, may be configured differently than the ones used in the Basic Training. Therefore what you hear on your computer could vary slightly from what you hear in the Basic Training. You should be able to follow along just fine even if there are some slight differences.</p></li> <li><p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/daisy/01-IntroductionJAWSBasicTraining-daisy.zip">1 JAWS Basic Training Introduction and Overview (DAISY)</a></p></li> <li><p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/daisy/02-GettingStartedWithJAWS-daisy.zip">2 Getting Started with JAWS (DAISY)</a></p></li> <li><p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/daisy/03-MenusDialogBoxesAndTheJAWSStartupWizard-daisy.zip">3 Menus, Dialog Boxes, and the JAWS Startup Wizard (DAISY)</a></p></li> <li><p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/daisy/04-UserInterfaceAndUtilities-daisy.zip">4 User Interface and Utilities (DAISY)</a></p></li> <li><p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/daisy/05-IntroductionToWindows-daisy.zip">5 Introduction to Microsoft Windows (DAISY)</a></p></li> <li><p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/daisy/06-ReadAndEditText-daisy.zip">6 Using the Keyboard to Read and Edit Text (DAISY)</a></p></li> <li><p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/daisy/07-IntroductionToFilesAndFolders-daisy.zip">7 Introduction to Files and Folders (DAISY)</a></p></li> <li><p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/daisy/08-JAWSHelp-daisy.zip">8 JAWS Help – Five Quick Ways to Get Help (DAISY)</a></p></li> <li><p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/daisy/09-SurfsUp-daisy.zip">9 Surf’s Up, Surfing the Internet, an Introduction (DAISY)</a></p></li> </ul> <h5 id="basic-training-mp3-files-for-jaws">Basic Training MP3 Files for JAWS</h5> <p>These MP3 files are packaged within ZIP files for downloading. After downloading them, you may extract them to any location on your computer.</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/mp3/01-IntroductionJAWSBasicTraining-mp3.zip">1 JAWS Basic Training Introduction and Overview (MP3)</a></li> <li><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/mp3/02-GettingStartedWithJAWS-mp3.zip">2 Getting Started with JAWS (MP3)</a></li> <li><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/mp3/03-MenusDialogBoxesAndTheJAWSStartupWizard-mp3.zip">3 Menus, Dialog Boxes, and the JAWS Startup Wizard (MP3)</a></li> <li><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/mp3/04-UserInterfaceAndUtilities-mp3.zip">4 User Interface and Utilities (MP3)</a></li> <li><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/mp3/05-IntroductionToWindows-mp3.zip">5 Introduction to Microsoft Windows (MP3)</a></li> <li><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/mp3/06-ReadAndEditText-mp3.zip">6 Using the Keyboard to Read and Edit Text (MP3)</a></li> <li><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/mp3/07-IntroductionToFilesAndFolders-mp3.zip">7 Introduction to Files and Folders (MP3)</a></li> <li><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/mp3/08-JAWSHelp-mp3.zip">8 JAWS Help – Five Quick Ways to Get Help (MP3)</a></li> <li><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/jaws-basic-training/mp3/09-SurfsUp-mp3.zip">9 Surf’s Up, Surfing the Internet, an Introduction (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <h5 id="basic-training-html-files-for-jaws">Basic Training HTML Files for JAWS</h5> <p>These are HTML files packaged within ZIP files for you to download and read at your convenience. After downloading them, you may extract them to any location on your computer.</p> <ul> <li><a and Improved Features in JAWS</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/picture-smart-ai/">Picture Smart AI</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/jaws-touch-gestures/">JAWS Touch Gestures</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/surfs-up/">Surf’s Up</a></li> </ul> <h3 id="getting-started-with-zoomtext-training-resources">Getting Started with ZoomText (Training resources)</h3> <h4 id="getting-started-with-zoomtext-2">Getting Started with ZoomText</h4> <p>The following is an overview of how ZoomText® works along with instructions for setting up basic visual and voice settings.</p> <h5 id="how-zoomtext-works-1">How ZoomText Works</h5> <p>Most of the time ZoomText works in the background providing a magnified and enhanced view that follows all of your activity. So as you move the mouse pointer, type text, and navigate your applications, your point of interest is always in view. If you are running ZoomText Magnifier/Reader, ZoomText also echoes and narrates what you are doing, audibly confirming where you are, what you type, and more.</p> <h5 id="starting-zoomtext-1">Starting ZoomText</h5> <p>When you first start ZoomText, the ZoomText toolbar appears, and your screen displays in Full view mode with 2x magnification. If you are running ZoomText Magnifier/Reader, speech is also enabled. If you need to briefly silence speech, press CTRL.</p> <h5 id="the-zoomtext-toolbar-1">The ZoomText Toolbar</h5> <p>The ZoomText toolbar has a streamlined layout that makes it easy to learn and fast to use. You can access and operate the entire toolbar using the mouse or the keyboard.</p> <p>Using the arrow keys on your keyboard, you can navigate the ZoomText menu, toolbar tabs, toolbar controls, and button menus. When the focus is on a split button, pressing the ENTER key toggles the feature, while pressing the Down arrow expands a list of settings.</p> <p>When the focus is in the Zoom Level box (on the Magnifier tab) or the Rate box (on the Reader tab), pressing the Up and Down arrow buttons adjust the zoom and rate values and pressing the Left and Right arrow buttons move the focus to the next control. Pressing the ENTER key on the Zoom Level box will also toggle the Zoom to 1x magnification.</p> <h5 id="setting-up-screen-brightness-and-magnification-1">Setting Up Screen Brightness and Magnification</h5> <p>Since the primary purpose of ZoomText is to make everything larger and easier to see, the first task is to adjust the zoom level (magnification) and screen colors for comfortable viewing.</p> <h6 id="step-1.-screen-brightness-1">Step 1. Screen Brightness</h6> <p>Let’s start by inverting screen brightness. The idea is to reduce glare and provide contrast to make it easier to view items on the screen.</p> <ul> <li>Press and hold the CAPS LOCK key and then press C, or</li> <li>Click the top half of the Color button on the Magnifier tab</li> </ul> <h6 id="step-2.-zoom-level-1">Step 2. Zoom Level</h6> <p>The next step is to find a zoom level that works best for you. When you start ZoomText for the first time, it magnifies the entire screen at 2x magnification. Magnification values range from 1.0x to 60x with incremental steps between 1.0x and 5.0x.</p> <ul> <li>To zoom in, press CAPS LOCK+UP ARROW</li> <li>To zoom out, press CAPS LOCK+DOWN ARROW</li> <li>You can also use the Zoom Level box on the Magnifier tab to change zoom levels. Note: To toggle between the current magnification level and 1x magnification, press CAPS LOCK+ENTER. This is a handy way of comparing how much of the display you can actually see when it is magnified.</li> </ul> <h5 id="setting-up-voice-and-echo-features-1">Setting up Voice and Echo Features</h5> <p>If you are running ZoomText Magnifier/Reader, ZoomText audibly echoes and narrates everything you do, so your second task is to adjust ZoomText’s voice rate and echo settings so that ZoomText speaks program activity the way you like. This includes how the keyboard is echoed when you type, and how ZoomText’s program echo announces menus, dialog boxes and other controls as you navigate through your applications.</p> <h6 id="step-1.-voice-rate-1">Step 1. Voice Rate</h6> <p>The first thing to decide with speech is how fast or slow you want ZoomText to speak. Initially, you may want to decrease the voice rate until you are comfortable with both listening to ZoomText speak and following where focus is on the screen.</p> <ul> <li><p>To increase the voice rate, press CAPS LOCK+ALT+UP ARROW</p></li> <li><p>To decrease the voice rate, press CAPS LOCK+ALT+DOWN ARROW Note: If speech becomes overwhelming at first, press CTRL to momentarily stop speech</p></li> <li><p>You can also change the voice rate using the Rate box on the Reader tab</p></li> </ul> <h6 id="step-2.-echo-features-1">Step 2. Echo Features</h6> <p>The mouse echo and keyboard echo settings let you control how much detail is spoken as you type on the keyboard and use the mouse. Try experimenting with these features to see if it is something that you want to use now or in the future.</p> <p>ZoomText can read the word or the line of text that you point to with the mouse pointer. This is known as mouse echo.</p> <ul> <li><p>To cycle through the different mouse echo settings, press CAPS LOCK+ALT+M</p></li> <li><p>You can also select the Mouse button on the Reader tab to change mouse echo features Keyboard echo is another echo feature that lets you hear characters, words, or both as you type.</p></li> <li><p>To cycle through the different keyboard echo settings, press CAPS LOCK+ALT+K</p></li> <li><p>You can also select the Keyboard button on the Reader tab to change keyboard echo features</p></li> </ul> <h5 id="the-next-step-1">The Next Step</h5> <p>The information provided above should allow you to start working productively in all of your applications. But there are many other features and settings to be learned that will help you optimize your use of ZoomText even more. So we recommend that you invest some time in exploring the entire help system to learn more about how to use ZoomText.</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/zoomtext/getting-started/">Getting Started with ZoomText</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/zoomtext/frequently-asked-questions/">ZoomText FAQ</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/zoomtext/zoomtext-hotkeys/">ZoomText® Hotkeys</a></li> </ul> <h3 id="jaws-faq">JAWS FAQ</h3> <h4 id="jaws-faq-1">JAWS FAQ</h4> <h5 id="what-is-jaws">What is JAWS?</h5> <p>JAWS®, Job Access With Speech, is a screen reader that provides access to the Microsoft Windows operating system as well as many popular applications for browsing the web, reading email, working with documents and spreadsheets, and much more. Information is spoken aloud as it appears and changes on the computer screen. In addition to speech, text on the screen can also be displayed in braille using a compatible refreshable braille display. To learn more, visit our JAWS product information page.</p> <h5 id="who-is-jaws-for">Who is JAWS for?</h5> <p>JAWS is for any computer user whose vision loss prevents them from seeing screen content or navigating with a mouse.</p> <h5 id="is-jaws-available-in-languages-other-than-english">Is JAWS available in languages other than English?</h5> <p>JAWS is available in many languages, some of which are available from our <a href="https://support.freedomscientific.com/Downloads/JAWS">download pages</a>. Additional languages are also available from your local distributor in many countries.</p> <h5 id="what-operating-systems-does-jaws-work-with">What operating systems does JAWS work with?</h5> <p>JAWS installs and works with Windows® 11, Windows 10, Windows Server® 2022, Windows Server 2019, and Windows Server 2016. Note that as Windows continues to change, new JAWS features may not be available in older versions of Windows.</p> <h5 id="what-versions-of-microsoft-office-does-jaws-work-with">What versions of Microsoft Office does JAWS work with?</h5> <p>JAWS works with Microsoft Office 365, or Microsoft Office 2016 and later. JAWS also supports older versions of Office (2013 and 2010) however there are no further enhancements coming for these older versions.</p> <p>JAWS has been tested to perform best with the latest Windows operating systems and software applications. As new versions ofFreedom Scientific products are released, support for older software may not continue.</p> <h5 id="what-web-browsers-work-with-jaws">What web browsers work with JAWS?</h5> <p>JAWS works with Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Internet Explorer. Support for Microsoft Edge is continuing to improve as well.</p> <h5 id="can-jaws-read-pdf-documents">Can JAWS read PDF documents?</h5> <p>Yes, JAWS reads accessible PDF documents. It also contains an option to perform Optical Character Recognition (OCR) on inaccessible scanned PDF documents so they can be read. If an inaccessible PDF is opened in Adobe Reader, JAWS displays a dialog asking if you want to OCR the document. Choose Yes to have JAWS recognize and display the text for reading.</p> <h5 id="can-i-read-my-email-with-jaws">Can I read my email with JAWS?</h5> <p>Definitely! Special attention has gone into the design of JAWS to make sure you have full access to email, especially with Microsoft Outlook from Office 365.</p> <h5 id="does-jaws-offer-any-magnification-features-for-low-vision-users">Does JAWS offer any magnification features for low vision users?</h5> <p>No, JAWS is intended for people who are not able to see the screen and need speech or braille to access Windows and applications. JAWS does however offer visual tracking features when reading web pages and PDF documents to help sighted teachers, parents, or testers have a better idea of where focus is on the screen as JAWS reads. If you have enough vision where you would benefit from more low vision features, then you should consider <a href="https://web.archive.org/web/20210622230239/%5Bfreedomscientific.com%5D(https://www.freedomscientific.com/Products/LowVision/Fusion)">Fus</a><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/Products/LowVision/Fusion">i</a><a href="https://web.archive.org/web/20210622230239/%5Bfreedomscientific.com%5D(https://www.freedomscientific.com/Products/LowVision/Fusion)">on</a> which offers both the screen reading features of JAWS and the screen magnification features of ZoomText to give you the best of both worlds.</p> <p>JAWS, Job Access With Speech, is a screen reader that provides access to the Microsoft Windows operating system as well as many popular applications for browsing the web, reading email, working with documents and spreadsheets, and much more. Information is spoken aloud as it appears and changes on the computer screen. In addition to speech, text on the screen can also be displayed in braille using a compatible refreshable braille display. To learn more, visit our JAWS product information page.</p> <p>JAWS is for any computer user whose vision loss prevents them from seeing screen content or navigating with a mouse.</p> <p>JAWS is available in many languages, some of which are available from our <a href="https://support.freedomscientific.com/Downloads/JAWS">download pages</a>. Additional languages are also available from your local distributor in many countries.</p> <p>JAWS installs and works with Windows® 11, Windows 10, Windows Server® 2022, Windows Server 2019, and Windows Server 2016. Note that as Windows continues to change, new JAWS features may not be available in older versions of Windows.</p> <p>JAWS works with Microsoft Office 365, or Microsoft Office 2016 and later. JAWS also supports older versions of Office (2013 and 2010) however there are no further enhancements coming for these older versions.</p> <p>JAWS has been tested to perform best with the latest Windows operating systems and software applications. As new versions ofFreedom Scientific products are released, support for older software may not continue.</p> <p>JAWS works with Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Internet Explorer. Support for Microsoft Edge is continuing to improve as well.</p> <p>Yes, JAWS reads accessible PDF documents. It also contains an option to perform Optical Character Recognition (OCR) on inaccessible scanned PDF documents so they can be read. If an inaccessible PDF is opened in Adobe Reader, JAWS displays a dialog asking if you want to OCR the document. Choose Yes to have JAWS recognize and display the text for reading.</p> <p>Definitely! Special attention has gone into the design of JAWS to make sure you have full access to email, especially with Microsoft Outlook from Office 365.</p> <p>No, JAWS is intended for people who are not able to see the screen and need speech or braille to access Windows and applications. JAWS does however offer visual tracking features when reading web pages and PDF documents to help sighted teachers, parents, or testers have a better idea of where focus is on the screen as JAWS reads. If you have enough vision where you would benefit from more low vision features, then you should consider <a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/Products/LowVision/Fusion">Fusion</a> which offers both the screen reading features of JAWS and the screen magnification features of ZoomText to give you the best of both worlds.</p> <p>JAWS is available from Freedom Scientific or your local Freedom Scientific dealer.</p> <p>Yes, like other Freedom Scientific products, JAWS can be installed and will work in a 40 minute mode. When that expires, reboot and it will work again in the same way. And, if an update comes out, it will alert you and allow it to update just as it does for licensed software.</p> <p>A few items you should look at customizing right away are how fast JAWS speaks, the amount of punctuation you hear, how keys are echoed as you type, whether or not JAWS starts automatically when Windows loads, how much information you hear as you navigate menus and dialogs, and selecting a Desktop or Laptop keyboard layout. If you are using a braille display, you may also want to choose whether text is shown in Computer Braille, or Grade 1 or grade 2. The JAWS Startup Wizard offers a convenient way to configure many of these commonly used settings including speech and braille preferences, verbosity settings, JAWS startup options, and more. The Startup Wizard automatically launches after a new JAWS installation. It can also be accessed anytime from the JAWS Help menu.</p> <p>Our training pages offer a series of basic training lessons in both text and audio to help you get started using JAWS. Our training resources can also be accessed directly from JAWS by opening the JAWS Help menu and choosing Training. In addition, check out our <a href="https://support.freedomscientific.com/Services/TrainingAndCertification/FreeWebinars">Free Webinars</a> page for hours of archived content demonstrating how you can get the most out of JAWS.</p> <p>Yes. JAWS works with many popular braille devices including our <a href="https://support.freedomscientific.com/Products/Blindness/FocusBlueBrailleDisplays">Focus Blue</a> series of braille displays.</p> <p>By default, JAWS will not speak as you move the mouse. However, there may be times when you need to access controls in a particular application that are not accessible from the keyboard. To turn on Mouse Echo, open Settings Center, press CTRL+SHIFT+D to load the default settings file, expand the Mouse Echo group, and press SPACEBAR on Enable Mouse Echo. Once enabled, JAWS speaks text under the mouse as it is moved around the screen.</p> <p>If you find that you struggle to keep the mouse in a straight line when moving vertically or horizontally, press and hold the INSERT key (or CAPSLOCK key in Laptop layout) as you move the mouse in a specific direction to lock the mouse pointer to that position. For example, if you locate a menu bar or group of buttons you would like to explore, you could press and hold INSERT as you move the mouse to the right. If you accidentally move slightly up or down, the mouse pointer remains locked to the current position.</p> <p>Absolutely! Use the following commands to access help information anytime you need it:</p> <ul> <li>Turn Keyboard Help on or off: INSERT+1 on the number row. When Keyboard Help is active, press any key combination to hear a description of the command without the keystroke actually being performed.</li> <li>Display context-sensitive help: INSERT+F1. Use this command to describe the current control or window.</li> <li>Hot key help: INSERT+H. This command lists JAWS keystrokes that may be useful in the application you are currently working in.</li> <li>Windows key help: INSERT+W. This lists some of the most commonly used Windows keystrokes.</li> <li>Open the main JAWS help system: F1 while focused in the main JAWS application window. The JAWS help contains a number of topics describing how to use various JAWS options and features. From the Contents pane, use the ARROW to select a topic and press ENTER to display it. Use F6 to move between the topic window and the table of contents. Use CTRL+TAB to cycle between Contents, Index, Search, and Favorites. JAWS contains a lot of commands and we understand that it is impossible for users and even instructors to remember them all. The Commands Search feature, which can be started by pressing INSERT+SPACEBAR followed by J, offers a quick way to locate JAWS keystrokes by allowing you to enter a full or partial description of the command whose keystroke you can’t remember. JAWS displays a list of commands that match your search criteria, a full description of the command, and all associated keystrokes including braille commands if a refreshable braille display is connected. See our <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/doccenter/rs25c51746a0cc/2014-09-10_jawscommandsearch/02_JAWSCommandSearch.htm">Commands Search</a> training lesson for more information and examples of using this feature.</li> </ul> <p>In addition to the Eloquence speech synthesizer that is installed by default with JAWS, You can download <a href="https://support.freedomscientific.com/Downloads/synthesizers">Vocalizer Expressive</a> voices from our website. These voices are free and offer very good speech quality in a variety of languages and dialects. JAWS also supports the voices included in Windows 10 as well as synthesizers from other companies that use the SAPI 5 interface.</p> <p>We do not keep a state by state list of instructors. However, you can complete the form on our <a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/Forms/DealerLocator">Dealer Locator</a> to find a Freedom Scientific distributor in your area. Many distributors offer training services that can be personalized to your specific needs. For users in the United States, you should also consider contacting your local Division of Blind Services for assistance with finding an instructor.</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/getting-started/">Getting Started With JAWS</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/new-and-improved-features/">New and Improved Features in JAWS</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/picture-smart-ai/">Picture Smart AI</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/fscompanion/">FSCompanion: Your AI-Powered Assistant for Learning JAWS and Microsoft Applications</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/additional-jaws-training-downloads/">Additional JAWS Training</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/frequently-asked-questions/">JAWS FAQ</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/hotkeys/">JAWS Hotkeys</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/jaws-touch-gestures/">JAWS Touch Gestures</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/surfs-up/">Surf’s Up</a></li> </ul> <h3 id="jaws-hotkeys-1">JAWS Hotkeys</h3> <h4 id="jaws-hotkeys-2">JAWS Hotkeys</h4> <p>To learn more about any of the keystrokes listed on this page, press the layered command, INSERT+SPACEBAR, F1, to open FSCompanion. id="jaws-training-1">JAWS Training</h4> <p>The JAWS® Training page is your one-stop source for finding free training materials, in a variety of formats, and on a range of topics.</p> <h5 id="getting-started-with-jaws-3">Getting Started with JAWS</h5> <p>Just installed your brand-new copy of JAWS on your Windows computer? Our Basic Training will help get you up and running with this powerful screen reader. This training is available for download in DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System), MP3, and HTML formats for you to listen to or read at your convenience.</p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/getting-started/">JAWS Getting Started</a></p> <h5 id="jaws-training-bundle-1">JAWS Training Bundle</h5> <p>You can also download the complete <a href="https://support.freedomscientific.com/Training/JAWS-Basic-Training.zip">JAWS Basic Training</a> as a ZIP file that you can extract to any location on your computer. It contains the entire Basic Training in MP3 and HTML format so you can listen or read at your convenience.</p> <h5 id="jaws-training-videos-1">JAWS Training Videos</h5> <p>Check out and subscribe to the <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCLlctxRAroB4ApeQd5b_I6A/videos?view=0&sort=dd&shelf_id=1">Freedom Scientific Training YouTube channel</a>. Our videos offer quick tips and hints for both new and experienced JAWS users. Watch a video to learn something new or refresh your skills.</p> <h5 id="additional-jaws-training-3">Additional JAWS Training</h5> <p>Learn more about using several popular JAWS features and how you can use them in various applications to increase your productivity. These lessons are available for download in both DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System) and MP3 format.</p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/additional-jaws-training-downloads/">Additional JAWS Training</a></p> <h5 id="surfs-up-browsing-the-web-with-jaws-2">Surf’s Up, Browsing the Web with JAWS</h5> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/surfs-up/">Surf’s Up</a> is a series of self-guided lessons that teach you to read and navigate the web using JAWS. Get started now.</p> <p>Don’t have time to review the lessons online? <a href="https://support.freedomscientific.com/SurfsUp/ZIP_Surfs_Up.zip">Download Surf’s Up</a> and learn offline at your own pace.</p> <p>Watch a brief <a href="https://youtu.be/ZAVFzQl8wYU">introduction to Surf’s Up</a> on our YouTube channel.</p> <h5 id="new-and-improved-features-in-jaws-1">New and Improved Features in JAWS</h5> <ul> <li>The <a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/picture-smart-ai/">Picture Smart AI</a> feature allows you to submit a photo to be analyzed and then displays a description of the picture in the JAWS Results Viewer window.</li> <li><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/fscompanion/">FSCompanion</a> is an AI assistant that helps you quickly find JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion features, keystrokes, and task instructions across multiple applications—without searching through multiple documents or web pages.</li> </ul> <h5 id="jaws-faqs-1">JAWS FAQs</h5> <p>Find answers to some of the most commonly asked questions about using JAWS.</p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/frequently-asked-questions/">JAWS FAQs</a></p> <h5 id="jaws-hotkeys-3">JAWS Hotkeys</h5> <p>JAWS has an extensive list of keyboard commands. Keyboard key combinations (called keystrokes or commands) provide quick and effective access to the entire scope of Windows features. Programs are opened, used, and closed. Letters are written and edited. Spreadsheets are compiled and calculated. Files are created, modified, and deleted. The Internet is browsed, and files and programs are downloaded. Through extensive use of keystrokes, the limitations of a graphical user environment are overcome.</p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/hotkeys/">JAWS Hotkeys</a></p> <h5 id="jaws-touch-gestures-3">JAWS Touch Gestures</h5> <p>If you have a computer running Windows that includes a touch screen, such as the Surface™ Pro tablet from Microsoft, you can control JAWS directly from the touch screen.</p> <p>Performing JAWS and Windows commands from a touch screen is accomplished by different touch gestures using one or more fingers. Gestures include taps, flicks, swipes, rotating, and pinching.</p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/jaws/jaws-touch-gestures/">JAWS Touch Gestures</a></p> <p><a Hotkeys</a></li> </ul></li> </ul> <h4 id="learn-ai-2">Learn AI</h4> <p>Unlock the Power of AI in the Workplace and discover how Artificial Intelligence (AI) can increase your productivity and independence. AI is reshaping how we work, from automating routine tasks to generating content and streamlining data.</p> <p>In this interactive training series, you will learn to use tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot to help you save time, stay organized, and focus on high-value tasks. We’ll also introduce you to JAWS®, ZoomText®, and Fusion® AI features like FSCompanion for guided learning, plus Picture Smart AI™ and the AI Labeler, which significantly enhance accessibility in applications and on the web. Whether you are just getting started or already exploring AI, we’ll introduce you to key concepts, define important AI terminology, and walk you through everyday tasks such as:</p> <ul> <li>Writing emails and drafting documents</li> <li>Summarizing content</li> <li>Analyzing and organizing data Learn at your own pace with interactive webinars, AI resources, and practice exercises that focus on accessibility and real-world application.</li> </ul> <h5 id="upcoming-ai-webinars">Upcoming AI Webinars</h5> <p>Join our monthly AI training webinar series to learn how AI tools can help you increase productivity in the workplace. Designed for all skill levels, this series starts with the basics and builds each month, offering a deeper understanding of AI concepts and practical applications. Webinars are held the first Thursday of every month at noon ET and are archived on our Webinars On Demand page—so you can stream or download sessions anytime and learn at your own pace. No prior AI experience needed!</p> <h6 id="using-ai-connectors-to-bring-your-everyday-apps-and-information-together">Using AI Connectors to Bring Your Everyday Apps and Information Together</h6> <p>Thursday, September 3, 2026, 12:00 pm Eastern time (U.S. and Canada)</p> <p>AI becomes even more powerful when it can work with the apps, files, and information you use every day. Instead of copying and pasting content between applications, AI connectors let you access and interact with information across multiple services from a single conversation.</p> <p>In this webinar, we’ll demonstrate how AI connectors can simplify everyday tasks and help you work more efficiently.</p> <p>You’ll learn how to:</p> <ul> <li>Connect AI to services such as email, calendars, cloud storage, and documents.</li> <li>Find information across connected apps without switching between them.</li> <li>Summarize emails, documents, and meeting information in seconds.</li> <li>Combine information from multiple sources to answer questions and complete tasks.</li> <li>Use practical workflows that save time at work, school, and home. Whether you’re organizing your day, researching a project, or managing documents, AI connectors can help you spend less time searching for information and more time getting things done.</li> </ul> <h6 id="vispero-presenters">Vispero Presenters:</h6> <p>Elizabeth Whitaker and Rachel Buchanan</p> <h6 id="acvrep-credits">ACVREP Credits:</h6> <p>ACVREP credits will be available for those who attend the live webinar.</p> <h6 id="help-us-spread-the-word">Help Us Spread the Word:</h6> <p>Please feel free to share this with someone you think might benefit from attending.</p> <p>Register for <a href="https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_luwf2V-5Q7y9fYs5mnrsnQ">Using AI Connectors to Bring Your Everyday Apps and Information Together</a>.</p> <p>Visit the <a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/freewebinars/">Webinars</a> page for a full list of upcoming training webinars.</p> <h5 id="ai-lessons">AI Lessons</h5> <p>Each lesson is a replay of an earlier webinar. They are organized in sequence so you can build confidence using AI with JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion.</p> <h6 id="breaking-down-barriers-an-introduction-to-using-ai-with-jaws-zoomtext-and-fusion.">Breaking Down Barriers – An Introduction to Using AI with JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion.</h6> <p>Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools are being used in the workplace to help automate tasks and increase productivity. In this lesson, we introduce you to several AI tools and show you how they can be used to perform tasks more efficiently using JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion. We also provide an overview of what AI is and walk you through a structured real-life workplace scenario.</p> <p>This lesson covers how to:</p> <ul> <li>Draft a project proposal email</li> <li>Analyze and summarize colleague feedback</li> <li>Create a project outline and timeline</li> <li>Draft a follow up email announcing the project <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2025_08_07_Intro_to_AI/Breaking-Down-Barriers-An-Introduction-to-Using-AI-with-JAWS-ZoomText-and-Fusion.mp3">Breaking Down Barriers – An Introduction to Using AI with JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2025_08_07_Intro_to_AI/Breaking-Down-Barriers-An-Introduction-to-Using-AI-with-JAWS-ZoomText-and-Fusion.mp4">Breaking Down Barriers – An Introduction to Using AI with JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion (MP4)</a></p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/learnai/breaking-down-barriers-practice-exercises/">Practice Exercises – Breaking Down Barriers: An Introduction to Using AI with JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion</a></p> <h6 id="ai-tips-tools-and-techniques-where-to-begin.">AI Tips, Tools, and Techniques: Where to Begin.</h6> <p>Are you ready to start using artificial intelligence with JAWS, ZoomText, or Fusion but not sure where to begin? Join us for this lesson which is designed to help you confidently take your first steps with AI tools in the workplace and beyond.</p> <p>In this interactive session, we:</p> <ul> <li>Define key AI terms like prompts, queries, models, and more—so you can understand the language of AI without the jargon.</li> <li>Demonstrate real-world examples of how to train and guide AI tools to complete everyday tasks efficiently.</li> <li>Walk through practical workplace scenarios, such as drafting a professional email, creating audience-specific documents, and extracting and analyzing key data from large text files into Excel spreadsheets. We also show you how you can specifically benefit from using Freedom Scientific’s AI features to learn JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion, plus other apps, describe images, and more. <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2025_09_04_AI_Tips/AI-Tips-Tools-and-Techniques-Where-to-Begin.mp3">AI Tips, Tools, and Techniques: Where to Begin (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2025_09_04_AI_Tips/AI-Tips-Tools-and-Techniques-Where-to-Begin.mp4">AI Tips, Tools, and Techniques: Where to Begin (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="an-introduction-to-chatgpt-conversations-creativity-and-clarity-1">An Introduction to ChatGPT: Conversations, Creativity, and Clarity</h6> <p>In this webinar, we explore how to harness the power of AI with JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion to make your workday more efficient. This session introduces ChatGPT, a conversational AI tool designed to help you manage daily tasks, boost productivity, and spark creativity. We explain what ChatGPT is, how it works, and the different versions available, along with how to access them.</p> <p>You will learn how to:</p> <ul> <li>Access different ChatGPT models</li> <li>Create a conversation using both text and voice</li> <li>Use that conversation to create a document</li> <li>Generate an Excel spreadsheet analyzing the data from the document</li> <li>Display the data in a graph</li> <li>Summarize the data in two emails targeted to different audiences <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2025_10_09_ChatGPT/An-Introduction-to-ChatGPT-Conversations-Creativity-and-Clarity.mp3">An Introduction to ChatGPT: Conversations, Creativity, and Clarity (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2025_10_09_ChatGPT/An-Introduction-to-ChatGPT-Conversations-Creativity-and-Clarity.mp4">An Introduction to ChatGPT: Conversations, Creativity, and Clarity (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="gemini-jumpstart-an-introduction-to-googles-generative-ai-1">Gemini Jumpstart: An Introduction to Google’s Generative AI</h6> <p>Discover How Google Gemini Can Enhance Your Productivity</p> <p>Curious about how Google’s Gemini AI can support your daily work? In this session, learn how to use Gemini with JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion to work smarter, faster, and more creatively.</p> <p>You will gain a clear understanding of what Gemini is, explore its available versions, and see how this powerful AI tool integrates seamlessly with Google Workspace applications to boost efficiency and accessibility in your workflow.</p> <p>In this session, you’ll learn how to:</p> <ul> <li>Access and navigate Gemini</li> <li>Summarize a file from Google Drive</li> <li>Analyze the data from that file</li> <li>Add events to your Google Calendar</li> <li>Use Gemini within Google Workspace applications to streamline daily tasks <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2025_11_06_Gemini_AI/Gemini-Jumpstart-An-Introduction-to-Googles-Generative-AI.mp3">Gemini Jumpstart: An Introduction to Google’s Generative AI (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2025_11_06_Gemini_AI/Gemini-Jumpstart-An-Introduction-to-Googles-Generative-AI.mp4">Gemini Jumpstart: An Introduction to Google’s Generative AI (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="an-introduction-to-copilot-crafting-confidence-and-capability-1">An Introduction to Copilot: Crafting Confidence and Capability</h6> <p>Ready to boost your productivity when using JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion with the AI built into your everyday tools? In this session, we introduce Microsoft Copilot, your AI assistant embedded within Office 365 apps like Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>We provide an overview of Copilot, explain the available versions and how to access them, and show you how to:</p> <ul> <li>Access and navigate Copilot</li> <li>Create a PowerPoint presentation proposing a new project</li> <li>Create an Excel spreadsheet based on the presentation to keep track of data and assign tasks to other team members</li> <li>Analyze the spreadsheet and create a document to use when collaborating on the project</li> <li>Request formatting tips for the final project document <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2025_12_04_Copilot/An-Introduction-to-Copilot-Crafting-Confidence-and-Capability.mp3">An Introduction to Copilot: Crafting Confidence and Capability (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2025_12_04_Copilot/An-Introduction-to-Copilot-Crafting-Confidence-and-Capability.mp4">An Introduction to Copilot: Crafting Confidence and Capability (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="research-reimagined-mastering-googles-notebooklm-with-jaws-1">Research Reimagined: Mastering Google’s NotebookLM with JAWS</h6> <p>Google’s NotebookLM is an AI-powered research and writing assistant that uses your own documents to ground its intelligence. It allows you to transform massive amounts of information into concise summaries, clear outlines, and insightful answers tailored to your specific project. By using this tool with JAWS, you can rapidly synthesize complex data and manage multiple sources within a streamlined, keyboard-friendly interface.</p> <p>In this session, we cover:</p> <ul> <li>Site Navigation: Mastering the layout using keyboard commands.</li> <li>Source Management: How to upload and categorize your research materials.</li> <li>AI Interaction: Asking the right questions to get the best summaries. <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_01_08_NotebookLM/Research-Reimagined-Mastering-Googles-NotebookLM-with-JAWS.mp3">Research Reimagined: Mastering Google’s NotebookLM with JAWS (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_01_08_NotebookLM/Research-Reimagined-Mastering-Googles-NotebookLM-with-JAWS.mp4">Research Reimagined: Mastering Google’s NotebookLM with JAWS (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="from-project-ideas-to-polished-writing-research-and-organize-with-claude-using-jaws-zoomtext-and-fusion-1">From Project Ideas to Polished Writing: Research and Organize with Claude Using JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion</h6> <p>Claude excels at long-form thinking, clear explanations, and working with complex information. In this webinar, you’ll explore practical ways to use Claude for outlining, organizing ideas, writing, summarizing, and analyzing content using JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion. We focus on practical, real-world strategies that help you work more efficiently and confidently, including how to:</p> <ul> <li>Navigating Claude using the keyboard.</li> <li>Managing multiple prompts and longer responses.</li> <li>Streamlining workflows.</li> <li>Building a repeatable process for research, organization, and writing. <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_02_05_Claude/Research-and-Organize-with-Claude-Using-JAWS-ZoomText-and-Fusion.mp3">From Project Ideas to Polished Writing: Research and Organize with Claude Using JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_02_05_Claude/Research-and-Organize-with-Claude-Using-JAWS-ZoomText-and-Fusion.mp4">From Project Ideas to Polished Writing: Research and Organize with Claude Using JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="the-power-of-productivity-accessing-copilot-in-office-365-with-jaws-1">The Power of Productivity: Accessing Copilot in Office 365 with JAWS</h6> <p>Microsoft Copilot is an AI-driven productivity tool integrated directly into the Office 365 suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. It functions as an intelligent assistant that can draft content, analyze data, and summarize lengthy email threads based on your specific prompts and existing files. By utilizing Copilot with JAWS, you can leverage powerful automation and natural language commands to navigate complex documents and streamline your daily workflow entirely from the keyboard.</p> <p>In this session, we cover:</p> <ul> <li>Navigate the Copilot Pane in Office 365 applications using the keyboard.</li> <li>Draft and revise content.</li> <li>Extract key points from large documents and organize data.</li> <li>Summarize long email threads in Outlook. <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_03_05_Copilot/The-Power-of-Productivity-Accessing-Copilot-in-Office-365-with-JAWS.mp3">The Power of Productivity: Accessing Copilot in Office 365 with JAWS (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_03_05_Copilot/The-Power-of-Productivity-Accessing-Copilot-in-Office-365-with-JAWS.mp4">The Power of Productivity: Accessing Copilot in Office 365 with JAWS (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="plan-organize-and-complete-projects-with-ai-1">Plan, Organize, and Complete Projects with AI</h6> <p>Learn how AI can help you plan projects, organize tasks, and manage daily responsibilities. This session demonstrates how you can use AI to create step-by-step plans, build task lists, prepare for meetings, and break complex goals into manageable actions with JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion.</p> <p>In this session, we demonstrate how AI can help you:</p> <ul> <li>Turn a large project or goal into a clear step-by-step action plan</li> <li>Create structured task lists for work projects or personal responsibilities</li> <li>Prepare for meetings with agendas, discussion points, and preparation checklists</li> <li>Organize complex tasks into manageable phases and priorities <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_04_02_AI_Projects/Plan-Organize-and-Complete-Projects-with-AI.mp3">Plan, Organize, and Complete Projects with AI (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_04_02_AI_Projects/Plan-Organize-and-Complete-Projects-with-AI.mp4">Plan, Organize, and Complete Projects with AI (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="conduct-in-depth-research-and-solve-complex-problems-using-ai-1">Conduct In-depth Research and Solve Complex Problems Using AI</h6> <p>Discover how AI helps you research topics, compare options, and solve everyday problems with JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion. This session demonstrates how to ask better questions, evaluate AI responses, and use AI to support decisions at work and at home.</p> <p>In this session, we demonstrate how AI can help you:</p> <ul> <li>Research unfamiliar topics and quickly build background knowledge</li> <li>Compare products, tools, or services based on your needs</li> <li>Break down complex problems and identify possible solutions</li> <li>Generate ideas and options when making decisions at work or home <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_05_07_AI/Conduct-In-depth-Research-and-Solve-Complex-Problems-Using-AI.mp3">Conduct In-depth Research and Solve Complex Problems Using AI (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_05_07_AI/Conduct-In-depth-Research-and-Solve-Complex-Problems-Using-AI.mp4">Conduct In-depth Research and Solve Complex Problems Using AI (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="use-ai-features-in-jaws-zoomtext-and-fusion-to-better-understand-and-navigate-digital-content-1">Use AI Features in JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion to Better Understand and Navigate Digital Content</h6> <p>Learn how the built-in AI features in JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion can help you work more efficiently and independently. This session will highlight practical tools that provide insight into your digital environment, enhance navigation, and make it easier to understand and interact with content across applications and on web pages.</p> <p>In this session, we’ll demonstrate how to:</p> <ul> <li>Use Vispero Companion to get help with JAWS, ZoomText, Fusion, and other applications</li> <li>Describe images, charts, and graphics using Picture Smart AI in applications, documents, and on web pages</li> <li>Identify unlabeled buttons and controls using AI Labeler</li> <li>Explore and understand complex web pages using Page Explorer <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_06_04_Digital_Content/Use-AI-Features-in-JAWS-ZoomText-and-Fusion-to-Better-Understand-and-Navigate-Digital-Content.mp3">Use AI Features in JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion to Better Understand and Navigate Digital Content (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_06_04_Digital_Content/Use-AI-Features-in-JAWS-ZoomText-and-Fusion-to-Better-Understand-and-Navigate-Digital-Content.mp4">Use AI Features in JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion to Better Understand and Navigate Digital Content (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="the-power-of-prompting-maximize-productivity-for-better-results-1">The Power of Prompting: Maximize Productivity for Better Results</h6> <p>AI responses are only as effective as the prompts that guide them. In this webinar, you discover practical prompting techniques that help you generate more accurate, useful, and refined results from AI tools. Through live demonstrations, we show how a simple prompt evolves through multiple revisions to produce stronger and more effective outcomes.</p> <p>In this session, you learn how to:</p> <ul> <li>Understand the key elements of an effective prompt.</li> <li>Guide AI to produce more useful and relevant responses.</li> <li>Refine prompts to improve and revise results.</li> <li>Use an iterative prompting process to complete a task and enhance it step by step. <a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_07_02_Prompting/The-Power-of-Prompting-Maximize-Productivity-for-Better-Results.mp3">The Power of Prompting: Maximize Productivity for Better Results (MP3)</a></li> </ul> <p>Note: If you want to save the MP3 and listen to it later, select the link to start the MP3 and then press CTRL+S.</p> <p><a href="https://doccenter.freedomscientific.com/doccenter/archives/2026_07_02_Prompting/The-Power-of-Prompting-Maximize-Productivity-for-Better-Results.mp4">The Power of Prompting: Maximize Productivity for Better Results (MP4)</a></p> <h6 id="from-prompting-to-productivity-building-better-ai-workflows-1">From Prompting to Productivity: Building Better AI Workflows</h6> <p>Over the past year, we explored a wide range of AI tools, prompting techniques, and real-world workflows. As AI becomes part of our daily routines, it’s a good time to revisit what we’ve learned, what’s become part of our everyday workflow, and the techniques that continue to deliver the best results.</p> <p>In this webinar, we:</p> <ul> <li>Revisit the AI tools we’ve explored and where they fit into today’s workflows.</li> <li>Review prompting techniques that consistently produce the best results.</li> <li>Demonstrate real-world tasks, comparing our approach then versus now.</li> <li>Highlight workflows that have grown more efficient as AI capabilities improve. Audio and video files available soon.</li> </ul> <h5 id="practice-exercises">Practice Exercises</h5> <p>These exercises are designed to help you practice using AI tools. Each exercise corresponds to a recorded lesson. Use them to practice tasks, gain new skills, and build your understanding of AI.</p> <p><a href="https://www.freedomscientific.com/training/learnai/breaking-down-barriers-practice-exercises/">Practice Exercises – Breaking Down Barriers: An Introduction to Using AI with JAWS, ZoomText, and Fusion</a></p> <h5 id="ai-tools">AI Tools</h5> <h6 id="freedom-scientific-ai-features">Freedom Scientific AI
